verses.1: Beloved, this is the second letter I am writing to you, in which I stir up your sincere minds by way of reminder,
verses.2: to recall the words previously spoken by the holy prophets and the command of the Lord and Savior given by your apostles.
verses.3: First, you must know this: in the last days there will arise mockers, walking in their own desires,
verses.4: and saying, "Where is the promise of his coming? For as long as the fathers have slept, all things remain as they were from the beginning of creation."
verses.5: This they do not want to remember, that the heavens were long ago and the earth formed from water and through water by the word of God,
verses.6: through which the former world was destroyed, being flooded by water.
verses.7: But the present heavens and earth are kept under the same word, stored up for fire, being preserved for the day of judgment and for the destruction of the ungodly.
verses.8: But do not let this fact escape your notice, beloved, that one day with the Lord is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.9: The Lord is not slow in fulfilling his promise, as some count slowness, but is being patient toward you, not wanting anyone to perish, but for all to come to repentance.
verses.10: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, in which the heavens will pass away with a roar, the elements will be burned up and dissolved, and the earth and the works that are in it will be found.
verses.11: Since then all these things will be dissolved, what manner of persons must you be in holy conduct and godliness,
verses.12: looking for and hastening the coming of the day of God, by which the heavens will be burned up and the elements will melt with fire;
verses.13: but we wait for new heavens and a new earth, according to his promise, in which righteousness dwells.
verses.14: Therefore, beloved, since you look for these things, be diligent to be found by him in peace, without spot and without blemish,
verses.15: and consider the patience of our Lord as salvation, just as also our beloved brother Paul, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
verses.16: as he does in all his letters, speaking in them about these things, in which are some things hard to understand, which the uninformed and unstable twist to their own destruction, just as they do with the rest of the scriptures.
verses.17: You therefore, beloved, knowing this beforehand, be on your guard, so that you may not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your own firm footing,
verses.18: but grow in grace and in the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.

notes:
Notes
- v. 13: "new heavens and a new earth" is a direct translation of καινοὺς οὐρανοὺς καὶ γῆν καινήν, reflecting the eschatological renewal.
- v. 15: "our beloved brother Paul" aligns with the Greek ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἡμῶν ἀδελφὸς Παῦλος, a respectful reference in the context of early Christian epistolary conventions.
